name: Clarity
author: Jose
description: Your game library in the bar and one keystroke away: how many games are installed, what is running right now, and a fuzzy launcher that starts any of them. Click to open Clarity, middle-click for Couch Mode on the couch.

barWidget.description: Installed games, and what is playing.

schema.label: Clarity command (optional)
schema.description: Leave empty. Clarity records its own location on every start and this widget reads it there — set a path only to override that, for a second copy of the app.

schema.label: Installer database (optional)
schema.description: Leave empty. library.db holds what is installed, and its location comes from the app rather than being guessed here — a second consumer deriving its own path is how the library got orphaned once before.

schema.label: Refresh seconds
schema.description: How often to re-check. The running-game check is cheap; the install count is only re-read when the database changes.
